title: Illusion Series
meta: Output: Diasec Print (Plexiglas + Alucobond), Fine Art Print (Hahnemühle Photo Rag / German Etching), Custom Archival on request
Framing: Diasec ready-to-hang with aluminum backing; fine art prints shipped rolled
statement:
'Illusion' is a meditation on the eye — not just as a physical form, but as an emotional reservoir, a silent mirror of all that is felt yet rarely expressed. These surreal, hyperreal eyes float in unfamiliar dreamscapes, suspended between worlds, wrapped in fluid textures that blur the boundaries between perception and reality.

Each gaze holds something back — a quiet resistance, a trembling truth. Emotion trembles just beneath the surface, held like water behind glass. The eyes in Illusion are not simply watching — they are containing. Holding pain, wonder, sorrow, and longing in the way only a human eye can: deeply, silently, and with dignity.

The more you look, the more you see. The more you see, the more you feel. And yet, it tells you nothing — it only reflects what you carry within.
